description: Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird has announced a lawsuit against TP-Link Systems for allegedly deceiving Iowans about the safety of their internet routers. The lawsuit alleges the company has violated the Iowa Consumer Fraud Act by allowing China to access the routers.
